neighbours.label: multiplier in a quantitative comparison (twice, three times, double)
fire: The new battery lasts four times longer than the old one.
Rents in the capital are now twice what they were in 2010.
The tower is three times taller than the church beside it.
Her salary is five times higher than her father's was.
This lens gathers twice as much light as a phone camera.
Cases rose ten times faster in the city than in the villages.
The ship carries three times the cargo of older vessels.
Imports grew twice as fast as exports last year.
quiet: The new battery lasts much longer than the old one.
Rents in the capital are now far above what they were in 2010.
The tower is a lot taller than the church beside it.
Her salary is much higher than her father's was.
This lens gathers more light than a phone camera.
Cases rose faster in the city than in the villages.
The ship carries more cargo than older vessels.
Imports grew faster than exports last year.

notes: card mixed (methods, twice, Ev|olutions, '},', today); output + pole promotes replace/instead. Probe: 'three times higher' 0.43, 'twice the frequency' 0.25, 'double the speed' 0.16, 'more sensitive than' 0.19.
